quick_skim.title: Online Robust Reinforcement Learning Through Monte-Carlo Planning
quick_skim.abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a powerful framework for solving complex decision-making problems, yet it often relies on the assumption that the simulator and the real-world dynamics are identical. Although this assumption helps achieve the success of MCTS in games like Chess, Go, and Shogi, the real-world scenarios incur ambiguity due to their modeling mismatches in low-fidelity simulators. In this work, we present a new robust variant of MCTS that mitigates dynamical model ambiguities. Our algorithm addresses transition dynamics and reward distribution ambiguities to bridge the gap between simulation-based planning and real-world deployment. We incorporate a robust power mean backup operator and carefully designed exploration bonuses to ensure finite-sample convergence at every node in the search tree. We show that our algorithm achieves a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$ for the value estimation at the root node, comparable to that of standard MCTS. Finally, we provide empirical evidence that our method achieves robust performance in planning problems even under significant ambiguity in the underlying reward distribution and transition dynamics.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: MCTS underpins game AI like AlphaZero but assumes the simulator matches reality. This work proposes a robust MCTS variant with a robust power-mean backup and exploration bonuses to handle transition and reward ambiguity, bridging simulation-based planning and real-world deployment with finite-sample guarantees.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 蒙特卡洛树搜索是AlphaZero等博弈AI的核心规划框架，但其依赖模拟器与真实动态一致的强假设，在低保真模拟中会产生建模偏差。本文提出一种鲁棒的MCTS变体，通过鲁棒幂均值回传算子与精心设计的探索奖励，同时处理转移动态与奖励分布的不确定性。该算法给出了有限样本保证，弥合了基于模拟的规划与真实世界部署之间的差距。其意义在于为AlphaZero式规划方法在不确定环境下的稳健应用提供了可迁移的技术路径。

quick_skim.title: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
quick_skim.abstract: Regularized self-play -- the family behind DeepNash's Stratego play -- drives a two-player zero-sum policy to a Nash equilibrium by best-responding to a slowly moving, entropy-regularized reference policy $ρ$. When the game has a polytope of value-equivalent equilibria, the regularizer silently breaks the tie: with a uniform reference it selects the maximum-entropy member, the I-projection of $ρ$ onto the Nash set. Can the reference be used to choose the equilibrium on purpose? On five exactly solvable games plus a 2-D polytope, with exact best responses and equivalence tests over independent seeds, anchoring the reference at a target member and refining steers self-play to that member with mean coordinate error 0.007 at median exploitability $5\times10^{-5}$, TOST-equivalent to the request within $\pm0.05$; the anchoring persists through refinement and follows the reference, not the initialization. Selection follows the reach-weighted I-projection (slope 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]). We report with equal emphasis where the story breaks: fixed off-manifold references cost 0.08-0.25 exploitability; stiff or flat families require a smaller mirror step, set by a pre-registered rule; boundary targets undershoot; curvature predicts where boundary saturation bites (rank correlation 0.90, p=0.037) while interior precision is curvature-independent. Table and MLP steering maps are equivalent within $\pm0.03$ at every target (30 seeds); matched control arms show attention's robust signature is excess seed variance, any systematic shift bounded at 0.018 and not significant. Against a best response the selection-robustness trade-off is degenerate: steering matters only against fixed, non-equilibrium opponents. The recipe -- anchor the reference at the desired member and refine -- reinterprets the KL anchor of RLHF-style RL as a selection knob, not only a stability leash.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 正则化自我对弈(DeepNash玩Stratego所用范式)通过最佳回应缓慢移动的参考策略收敛到纳什均衡,但当博弈存在价值等价均衡多面体时,正则项会静默打破平局,默认选出最大熵均衡。本文研究能否有意利用参考策略来选择目标均衡。作者在五个可精确求解博弈及一个二维多面体上,用精确最佳回应与多随机种子等价性检验,证明将参考锚定到目标均衡并加以细化可将自我对弈导向该均衡,平均坐标误差仅0.007。该结果揭示了自我对弈均衡选择的可控性,对理解AlphaZero类自我对弈训练有方法借鉴意义。
